svg.aria-label: Breadboard wiring for the LED and the button
svg.text: Lesson 1 on the breadboard: LED on GPIO25, button on GPIO33
Two breadboards pushed together; the board bridges them. Shaded bars are the 5-hole strips joined inside.
J3 (pin names as printed on the board)
W1: GPIO25 strip → R1 (330 Ω) → LED1 long leg; LED1 short leg (flat side) → GND rail.
W2: GPIO33 strip → S1; the other leg of S1 → GND rail. A J2 GND pin feeds the GND rail.
4-leg buttons: use two diagonally opposite legs, so the internal pairs cannot fool you.
